defect: The new loop assigns the constant EBOOT.OLD path instead of altBootNames[i] when any alternate boot file exists (and lists PAKFILE2.BIN under SYSDIR instead of USRDIR), so most patched games boot a nonexistent file.
reason: Both lines the fix corrects were added by this refactor, and the wrong assignment is plain in the diff.

defect: FlushAll's added static check for the second register of a pair tests mr[i].isStatic instead of mr[i + 1].isStatic, so a static reg can be paired into a scratch STP (and static ML_IMM regs now used via SetImm keep ML_IMM after being materialized).
reason: The copy-paste index error is in a line this change added and the fix corrects exactly that line.

defect: CopyDisplayToOutputInternal now calls SetRenderFrameBuffer, which picks or creates a framebuffer from the current gstate at display time instead of rebinding the last render target, causing artifacts (Jeanne d'Arc world map).
reason: The fix replaces exactly the added SetRenderFrameBuffer call with RebindFramebuffer; seeing why it is wrong needs Framebuffer.cpp.

defect: SUB(Rd, Ra, Rb) emits SUBF(Rd, Ra, Rb), which on PowerPC computes Rb - Ra, so the operands are reversed.
reason: The new inline SUB is wrong by PPC subf semantics and the fix swaps its operands.

defect: PrepareRead/PrepareWrite are passed a fixed size of 4 for all access widths, so byte and halfword accesses check a 4-byte range and trip memchecks that were not hit.
reason: The size argument was added by this change as the constant 4 although the bits parameter was available; the fix uses bits / 8.

defect: Comp_VDot now allows dregs[0] to equal sregs[0] (DestRegOverlaps ignores index di) but maps the destination with MAP_NOINIT, so the source value is never loaded and the dot product reads garbage.
reason: The overlap allowance and NOINIT mapping were both added here; the fix makes VDot reject that overlap (IsOverlapSafe).

defect: ResolveSyscall patches the import stub with JAL instead of J, overwriting ra so the called module function returns into the stub instead of the caller.
reason: ResolveSyscall is new in this change and the fix changes exactly that JAL to J.

defect: The newly added 5551 alpha multiplier 1/128 maps a 1-bit alpha to palette index 2 instead of 1 (the fix uses 1/256); the case labels 4/8 it also fixes were already wrong before.
reason: At least one corrected value (the alpha multiplier) was introduced by this change; the shift-label typos and the Clear() map clearing predate it.

defect: ApplyTexture computes the full hash into an unused local instead of entry->fullhash (the old entry->fullhash assignment was removed), so rebuilt textures keep a stale hash.
reason: The dropped assignment and dead local are in lines this change wrote; the fix assigns entry->fullhash.

defect: hleLagSync scales the 1 ms wait by iFpsLimit / 60 instead of 60 / iFpsLimit, so alternate speeds sync in the wrong direction.
reason: The inverted ratio is in the newly added function and the fix flips it.

defect: NID 0x28235C56 (sceAudioRoutingGetVolumeMode) is bound to sceAudioRoutingSetVolumeMode with an int argument, so games calling the getter run the setter with a garbage argument.
reason: The wrong NID-to-function mapping was added by this new file and the fix rebinds it; the correct NID can only be known from PSP documentation.

defect: PointerWrap is forward-declared as struct while it is defined as a class, which breaks the MSVC build (class-key mismatch changes name mangling).
reason: The forward declaration is new here and the fix changes it to class; knowing PointerWrap is a class needs ChunkFile.h.

defect: ClearBuffer calls glClearDepth(1.0), which does not exist in OpenGL ES 2, breaking GLES builds; the fix uses glClearDepthf.
reason: The call was added by this change in a file shared by GL and GLES (USING_GLES2 ifdefs are visible in the context).

defect: ~VKContext deletes allocator_ immediately although freed texture memory has queued DispatchFree callbacks pointing at the allocator, causing a use-after-free when the delete queue runs on shutdown.
reason: The delete allocator_ line was added by this change and the fix defers it through the delete queue; the queued callbacks are in VulkanMemory.cpp.

defect: The new background ReplacedTextureTask holds a raw reference to the texture and its LimitedWaitable, and IsReady releases (deletes) the waitable as soon as triggered_ is seen while Notify may still hold its mutex (Wait predicates are also inverted), so destroying or releasing races with the loader thread and can crash.
reason: The fix reworks the waitable release and synchronization introduced by this change's threaded loading; WaitAndRelease deleting the object is defined in another file.

defect: sceKernelCancelWakeupThread uses uid == __KernelGetCurThread() (comparison) instead of assignment, so uid 0 is never mapped to the current thread.
reason: The typo is in the newly added function and the fix changes == to =.

defect: The legacy savestate reader uses float l4[3] for the old 4-float lightangle and lightspot arrays, misreading older savestates.
reason: The undersized array was added by this change (its name l4 shows the intended size) and the fix makes it [4].

defect: The added empty-view guard in ClampScrollPos sets pos = 0 but does not return, so views_[0] is still dereferenced for an empty ScrollView.
reason: The unchecked views_[0] access predates this change (empty ScrollViews crashed before it); the change only added an incomplete guard that the fix completes.

defect: decodePos advances by ATRAC_MAX_SAMPLES past bufferSize and the unsigned (bufferSize - decodePos) underflows, so numSamples never reaches 0 and looping never restarts.
reason: The loop and sample-count logic were added by this change and the fix adds the decodePos >= size check.

defect: A single audioBuffer_ is refilled and resubmitted while XAudio2 still holds up to bufferCount queued references to it, corrupting queued audio (glitches).
reason: The single-buffer design is new in this rewrite (the old code used a ring buffer) and the fix makes it per-buffer.

defect: The vertical branch tests measuredWidth_ < vert.size instead of measuredHeight_ when deciding to grow the height.
reason: The copy-paste error is in a line this change added and the fix replaces it.

defect: The ElfReader destructor is empty although LoadInto allocates sectionOffsets and sectionAddrs with new[], leaking them (and members are left uninitialized).
reason: The initial snapshot added the empty destructor; the fix adds the delete[] calls; the allocations are in ElfReader.cpp.

defect: AlphaToPremul4444 is passed the whole 32-bit RGBA pixel instead of its alpha byte (>> 24), so it takes bits 4-7 of the red channel and SDL text renders wrong.
reason: The call was added by this change and the fix adds >> 24; the function's 8-bit expectation is in draw_text.h.

defect: sceAtracSetHalfwayBufferAndGetID was given an extra atracID first parameter (WrapI_IUUU), shifting all real arguments (halfBuffer, readSize, halfBufferSize) by one.
reason: The wrong signature was introduced when this change wrapped the function, and the fix removes the parameter; the sibling SetDataAndGetID in the same diff takes no ID.

defect: mipsr4k.Reset() was moved after CoreTiming::Init and HLEInit, so it wipes MIPS state they set up (for example downcount and the JIT).
reason: The fix moves the call back before CoreTiming::Init; what Reset clobbers is in MIPS.cpp.

defect: On Linux realpath strips the trailing slash, so path = rootNorm has no separator and DirectoryFileSystem builds wrong host paths when mountRoot is used.
reason: The mountRoot path handling is new in this change and the fix appends the slash; the separator requirement lives in DirectoryFileSystem.

defect: Root margins subtract only right/bottom from width/height after offsetting by left/top, and the root is measured at the full size, so content is shifted and cut off.
reason: The margin arithmetic was added here and the fix subtracts both margins and measures with the reduced size.

defect: The refactored PCM path does memset(output + size, ...) with output an s16 pointer and size in bytes, zeroing the wrong region and writing past the buffer when a PCM voice wraps.
reason: The faulty zero-fill was introduced by this refactor and the fix's rewrite of the PCM read removes it (the loop-position part of the fix is new behaviour).

defect: The added raw glEnable(GL_BLEND) and glBlendFunc calls bypass the glstate cache, leaving the emulator's cached blend state out of sync with GL.
reason: The fix replaces these calls with glstate and Restore(); the earlier raw glDisable calls had the same flaw, and the cache use is in other GPU files.

defect: FindOptimumFont marks the nearest-size candidate by setting q = MATCH_GOOD, but any later font that merely matches the style fields also overwrites optimumFont, so the nearest size is lost.
reason: The nearest-match logic is new in this change and the fix tracks nearestFont separately.

defect: TextStringEntry has a Thin3DTexture member only on Win32 while the shared draw_text code now uses texture, breaking Linux and Android builds.
reason: The platform-conditional member was added here and the fix makes texture unconditional; the use is in draw_text.cpp.

defect: CtrlMatrixList::GetColumnText dereferences gpuDebug without a null check (GetRowCount checks it), crashing the matrix tab when no GPU debug interface exists.
reason: The function is new in this change and the fix adds the missing !gpuDebug check.

defect: GetDirListing looks up getFileListIndex with the bare entry name instead of the path relative to the disc root, so startSector is not found for files in subdirectories.
reason: The lookup was added by this change (GetFileInfo in the same diff passes the full path) and the fix builds path + / + name.

defect: The per-row memchecks in writeVideoImageWithRange use bufferPtr + frameWidth * bpp without the row index y, checking the same row every time.
reason: The memcheck calls were added here and the fix multiplies by y.

defect: The EP index range checks use epid > EPMap.size() instead of >=, allowing an out-of-bounds read of EPMap[size].
reason: The off-by-one checks were added by this change and the fix changes them to >=.

defect: TestBoundingBoxThrough compares x and y against the inclusive scissor right/bottom without the +1 pixel edge, culling draws on the edge (and a non-float position format falls through with unfilled verts).
reason: The function is new in this change and the fix adds the +1 and restructures the format switch; the inclusive scissor semantics are defined elsewhere.

defect: __UsbMicDoState restores numNeedSamples and waiting threads but not audioBuf, then calls availableAudioBufSize() (audioBuf->getAvailableSize()) and later skips reallocation because the size matches, dereferencing a null audioBuf.
reason: The DoState and the numNeedSamples-based allocation check were added here; the fix allocates audioBuf on load.

defect: In the shift == 0 branch the format string takes mask and offset but is passed shift, mask, offset, so the shader gets mask 0 and the mask as offset.
reason: The new branch has the wrong argument list and the fix drops shift.

defect: srcY is offset only when srcYOffset >= (u32)-1, that is when no source framebuffer matched (adding -1), and never when one did.
reason: The comparison typo is in a line this change added and the fix changes it to !=.

defect: Save calls network->Set(EnableWlan, &bEnableWlan, true), passing a pointer (always true) to the value-with-default overload, so the setting is never written to the ini.
reason: The faulty Set call was added here and the fix passes bEnableWlan; the default change to false is a separate policy change.
